integrity: Exact coefficient enumeration, independent finite-field singular witnesses and algebraic-closure Gröbner tests are included with reproducible code and reference outputs.
scientific_limitations: Finite F2 split-quadric smooth bidegree-(3,3) embedded curves only; all even-contact planes counted, including nonreduced contacts; classification is not a statement about all genus-four curves or characteristic-zero tritangents; residual unindexed-priority uncertainty.
title: Four rational even-contact planes on binary split-quadric genus-four curves
